blocks.text:
Fire department goes into earthquake mode and deploys teams from 106 stations to examine buildings for damage

An earthquake of preliminary magnitude 5 hit the area of Manhattan Beach, California, on Saturday morning, according to the United States Geological Survey (USGS). There were no immediate reports of injuries or damage.

The Los Angeles fire department went into earthquake mode, deploying personnel from 106 neighborhood fire stations to examine infrastructure for damages. No injuries or structural damage has been reported, the department said in an alert.
